summary: Iteration 911 FINAL RETEST of the three iter_910 bugs for free user (p1.free.1779113329@example.com) on /features/travel-visa @ 1920x1080. RESULTS: BUG1 (quota-pill click interception) = FIXED ✅ — onboarding overlay is now position:fixed, zIndex 1200, so clicking [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-continue'] with the [data-testid='feature-quota-pill'] still visible in the DOM (at y=1017) SUCCEEDS from step 1 → step 2 → step 3 without any pointer-event interception. BUG3 (theme-toggle on feature route) = FIXED ✅ — [data-testid='theme-toggle'] is present in FeatureLayout header on /features/travel-visa; clicking toggles bg from light rgb(248,250,252) to dark rgb(5,10,24), main dashboard renders correctly in dark (25 flagcdn imgs still visible, htmlBg=bodyBg=rgb(5,10,24) — no white bottom strip), toggles back to light on second click. REGRESSION = PASS ✅ — 25 flagcdn.com images on main dashboard, Top Countries + Region Filter + Trending Destinations sections all render. BUG2 (step-3 level cards visible in viewport) = STILL FAILING ❌ — after step 2 Continue click, the three level cards [tv-v2-onboarding-level-beginner|intermediate|expert] render at DOM y=-234 (above the visible viewport, viewportH=1080, windowScrollY=0). The 3-column layout is correct (xs=480/797/1115, same y=-234, w=305 each), but the cards are entirely above the visible area. The useEffect on currentStep DOES reset window.scrollY to 0 (confirmed windowScrollY=0), but the inner RN-Web ScrollView is still scrolled ~360px down when step 3 mounts, so scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0}) is not being honoured (RN Web ScrollView's underlying scroll node is not reset).

ui_bugs.issue: Level cards render at getBoundingClientRect().y = -234 (above viewport) after clicking Continue on step 2. windowScrollY=0 confirms outer window is reset, but the inner ScrollView (RN Web) retains its scroll position (~360px) from step 2. iter_911 fix (scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0}) inside useEffect on currentStep) does NOT actually reset the RN-Web ScrollView's DOM scrollTop. Cards ARE in DOM and layout is correct 3-column, but visually the entire step-3 body is offscreen — real free users see a blank overlay with only Back / Get Started buttons visible. Reproduction: free user @1920x1080, complete steps 1 (US) and 2 (Tourist) → step 3 blank.

integration_issues.issue: After iter_911 fix, step 1→2 and continue clicks work (pill no longer intercepts), but step 3 body renders offscreen. Onboarding can only be completed by scrolling inside the overlay to bring the level cards into view. Real users on desktop 1920x1080 encounter a blank overlay with disabled Get Started.

action_items: RESIDUAL BUG (BUG2): The useEffect on currentStep in TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx does scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0}), but this does NOT reset the inner scroll position on RN Web because react-native-web's ScrollView.scrollTo does not reliably reset the DOM node's scrollTop when the container has flex:1 with contentContainerStyle. RECOMMENDED FIXES (try one): (a) After the ScrollView renders, in the useEffect on currentStep, walk the DOM and find the actual scrollable descendant of the overlay and set its scrollTop = 0 directly: `const overlay = document.querySelector('[data-testid="tv-v2-onboarding-overlay"]'); overlay?.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(el => { if (el.scrollTop > 0) el.scrollTop = 0; });` inside a setTimeout(0). (b) Alternatively, use a native <div> with overflow:auto instead of RN ScrollView on web, and set its ref.scrollTop = 0. (c) Or set `key={currentStep}` on the ScrollView so React remounts a fresh ScrollView on each step transition (starts at scrollTop=0).
critical_code_review_comments: TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx line 63-70: scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0}) is being called on currentStep change but is NOT effective on RN Web. Verified via DOM inspection: level cards at y=-234 with windowScrollY=0 means an intermediate scrollable div (the ScrollView's DOM projection) retained scrollTop from step 2. RN Web's scrollTo needs a slight delay or a direct DOM-node reset. Add: if (Platform.OS==='web') { setTimeout(() => { document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="tv-v2-onboarding-overlay"] *').forEach(el => el.scrollTop = 0); }, 0); }
TravelVisaMain.tsx: onboarding overlay position:fixed zIndex 1200 fix (BUG1) is CORRECT and effective — no regressions observed with quota pill click interception.

FeatureLayout.tsx line 177-185: theme-toggle button is CORRECTLY implemented (BUG3 fix). Sun/moon icon swaps, calls setThemeMode, propagates dark styling to entire dashboard including KPIs, flag imgs, and page bottom.
Console noise: /api/auth/me still returns 401 (bootstrap) and 403 (some requests) before session_renew_success — logged as errors on every visit. Not new, not blocking, but noisy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: iter_911 confirms BUG1 (quota-pill overlay z-index) and BUG3 (theme-toggle in FeatureLayout header) are RESOLVED. Only BUG2 remains: RN-Web ScrollView.scrollTo({y:0}) is not effective — the inner ScrollView keeps its scrollTop from the previous step, rendering step-3 level cards at y=-234 above the visible viewport. Recommended fix path is to directly set DOM scrollTop=0 on the overlay's scrollable descendant in a setTimeout(0), OR remount the ScrollView with key={currentStep}. Selectors: [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-country-us'] (LOWERCASE country code — this bit iter_910's tests), [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-visa-tourist'] (visa-type step uses 'visa-' prefix, NOT 'purpose-'), [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-level-beginner|intermediate|expert'], [data-testid='tv-v2-onboarding-continue'] (works as Get Started on final step). Login testids unchanged (login-email-input / login-password-input, SIGN IN button). Cloudflare 429 was aggressive — space actions with >=3s waits and use domcontentloaded.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG2 (unresolved): TravelVisaOnboarding.tsx uses a React Native ScrollView which on web is projected as a <div style='overflow:auto'>. The imperative call scrollRef.current?.scrollTo({y:0, animated:false}) inside useEffect on currentStep IS invoked (verified by windowScrollY resetting to 0), but the underlying react-native-web ScrollView.scrollTo does not reliably set the DOM node's scrollTop on web when contentContainerStyle uses flexGrow:1. Evidence: the level-beginner card renders at getBoundingClientRect().y = -234 with windowScrollY = 0, meaning ~234px of internal scroll offset remains inside the ScrollView. Two-line fix: (a) key={currentStep} on <ScrollView>, forcing a remount that starts at scrollTop=0; or (b) after the scrollTo call, in a setTimeout(0), walk `document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="tv-v2-onboarding-overlay"] *')` and set el.scrollTop = 0 to defensively catch whatever intermediate scroller RN Web created.
